title: Subsets
statement: Return all possible subsets (the power set) of a list of distinct integers, including the empty subset, in any order.

hints.1_question: Every prefix of the decision process is already a valid subset. When should you record?
hints.2_nudge: Record the current subset at every call, then try adding each later element.
hints.3_big_hint: bt(start): res.append(cur[:]); for i in range(start, n): cur.append(nums[i]); bt(i+1); cur.pop().

known_bugs.name: misses the empty subset
known_bugs.followup: Is the empty set a subset of every set?

known_bugs.name: never includes the last element
known_bugs.followup: Which elements can your loop pick? Is the last one among them?

known_bugs.name: only builds prefixes
known_bugs.code:
def subsets(nums):
    return [nums[:i] for i in range(len(nums) + 1)]
known_bugs.followup: For [1, 2] you should get 4 subsets. How many do you produce, and which is missing?

followups: How would a bitmask enumeration solve it?
How does the answer change if there are duplicates (problem 90)?
